elements.text:
Rift tears space and time open in front of the caster. Behind the tear is a corner of the astral plane, and it belongs to whoever opened it.

  Right-click it to store things there. It can store an infinite amount of items making the rift bigger and bigger each time.

  Crouch in the tear for 4 seconds before the countdown starts and instead and you are pulled through the rift into the astral plane. On the other side everything you stored is lying on the floor of a long hall. Crouch and right-click a thing to take it back.

  The way back stands behind you. It puts you down where you were, and nothing outside has moved on.

  It holds for 20 seconds, and 20 seconds longer for every charge level above the first.

  This mechanic's visuals will not work well with shaders.
